visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a metal spoon lifting thick, translucent glutinous rice porridge from a blue-patterned ceramic bowl. Visible ingredients include plump grains of rice and a whole, dark-colored dried longan. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the steam and the glossy texture of the food. (2) Close-up view of white, elastic mochi pieces being pulled and dipped into a dark, coarse mixture of black sesame powder and sugar using wooden sticks. The focus is sharp on the texture of the powder adhering to the sticky surface. (3) A staff member in a bright green uniform and purple gloves is seen in a medium shot, using a large metal ladle to serve a bowl of hot dessert from a large stainless steel vat. The background is a clean, industrial-style kitchen setting. (4) An elderly man with glasses, wearing a blue and white horizontal striped polo shirt, speaks directly to the camera. He is positioned in front of stainless steel kitchen equipment, appearing as the shop owner. (5) A montage of close-ups showcasing different sweet soups. One bowl features glutinous rice with longan, while another shows a creamy white peanut soup filled with small, colorful red and white glutinous rice balls. (6) Close-up of mochi balls boiling in a large pot of water, followed by a shot of them being coated in fine peanut powder. The camera remains static to emphasize the preparation process. (7) A high-angle shot of a wall-mounted menu board with Traditional Chinese text and prices, followed by a final shot of a person in a grey graphic hoodie walking away from the market stall towards an outdoor street during the daytime.
